hero.title: Four divisions.
hero.lead: Apex Holdings Limited manages manufacturing and export-oriented enterprises across frozen and convenience foods, textiles and apparel, agriculture, specialty chemicals and renewable energy.

map.title: One holding company, four engines of growth
map.intro: AHL was formed in 1998 to coordinate and keep control over a growing family of companies. Select a division to see the companies behind it.

divisionsHeading.title: Meet the companies
divisionsHeading.intro: Every company runs with its own expertise, backed by the shared standards, governance and values of the Apex group.

mix.title: A balanced, export-led portfolio
mix.intro: Twelve companies across four divisions. Hover the chart or the legend to compare them.

journey.title: Decades of steady growth
journey.intro: From one export-oriented plant in 1980 to a diversified group.

cta.title: Let's build what comes next, together
cta.text: Whether you are a buyer, partner or investor, our team will connect you with the right company in the group.
